title: Meta Special Ad Categories — campaign selection
excerpts: When you create a campaign, you are required to specify if you are running an ad to promote a Special Ad Category.
summary: Meta requires advertisers to identify campaigns promoting a Special Ad Category. Paraphrase.

title: Meta Special Ad Categories — rejection
excerpts: Ads may be rejected if the advertiser does not choose an appropriate Special Ad Category.
summary: Meta may reject ads when an appropriate Special Ad Category is not selected. Paraphrase.

title: Meta Special Ad Categories — audience selection
excerpts: Limited audience selection tools for ads about employment, housing opportunities or financial products and services to help protect people from unlawful discrimination across our platforms
summary: Meta describes limited audience selection tools for specified ad categories to protect against unlawful discrimination. Paraphrase.
